data.gender_notes: Mira is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Mira is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mīrā’, which means ‘star of the sea’. It is believed that the name Mira was given to the goddess Parvati when she emerged from the ocean as a star to reunite with Lord Shiva. Therefore, the name Mira is often associated with love, compassion, and the power of the universe.
